item.title: Amir’s Shockwave: Hotfix 43.5.3
item.description:
Changes:

  • Nightwave Radio now plays from the Nightwave console in the Backrooms if the Nora Night Volume slider is not set to zero.
  • Updated the description of Athodai Prime's unique trait Overdrive to specify it triggers on weakpoint kills (previously said headshot).
  • Ally Gemini Skin voice lines are now affected by the Enemy & Ally Combat Volume slider in the Advanced Sound Effects Mixer.
  • Improved handling of corrupt shader caches, which could result in crashing.

Surge Eximus Changes & Fixes:

  • Surge Eximus' electricity ability now has a maximum casting range of 50m. 
  • Fixed additional cases of Surge Eximus units causing Clients to crash in Uranus Proxima and Deep Mines missions.
  • Fixed the Surge Eximus' electricity ability not being affected by Banshee's Silence.
  • Fixed the Surge Eximus' electricity ability dealing damage across two ticks instead of one.
    • The actual damage output from the electric shocks is unchanged.
  • Fixed Surge Eximus being able to target invisible players. 

Top Fixes:

  • Fixed Tempera Amp Skin causing Drifter Amps with an Alt-Fire to sometimes not respond to Alt-Fire inputs or the Fire Manual Trigger Weapons Continuously toggle.
    • Also fixed misaligned VFX when firing.
    • Known Issue: This issue persists for Operators with the Tempera Amp Skin equipped. We recommend using a different Amp skin for the time being if you are affected.
  • Fixed Hildryn being able to stack Void Relic opening Ability Strength buffs if it was triggered while she was in Aegis Storm. 
  • Fixed the Vectis (Prime) not having a fully reloaded magazine after exiting Incarnon Form.

Fixes:

  • Fixed being able to drag tints into a Signa's X and Y axis setting in the Appearance menu. 
  • Fixed metallic elements in the Backrooms appearing black for systems with low graphics settings.
  • Fixed various minor decoration issues in Höllvandeim, including a poster not displaying properly, and Lettie's seat missing her lumbar support pillow. 
  • Fixed being unable to place Dojo Decorations in the portal’s dissolve range of the Courtier's Bliss and Harbinger's Pass Dojo Rooms.
  • Fixed Kubrows and Kavats having a duplicate listing of their default fur pattern.
  • Fixed a crash when interacting with the KIM system.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1519687-known-issues-amirs-shockwave/

item.title: Amir’s Shockwave: Hotfix 43.5.4
item.description:
Fixes:

  • Fixed lighting in the Backroom causing various metallic items to appear significantly darker than before.
  • Fixed Yareli being unable to initiate Last Gasp if Merulina had died before Last Gasp was triggered.
  • Fixed Surge Eximus becoming braindead after being Silenced mid-sprint.
  • Fixed Tempera Amp Skin causing Operator Amps with an Alt-Fire to sometimes not respond to Alt-Fire inputs or the Fire Manual Trigger Weapons Continuously toggle.
  • Fixed DJ Shockwave's transmissions and radio broadcasts being a little too loud.
  • Fixed performance issues caused by Arthur's Exalted Blade and Quincy's Neutralizer in the special Fables & Frontiers mission.
  • Fixed performance issues related to Surge Eximus electricity attacks.
  • Fixed Daiku and Daiku Prime's animations being broken with certain bow skins equipped.
  • Fixed a script error when customizing loadouts.
  • Fixed a crash related to Baruuk's Elude.

For list of known issues that are on our radar, visit our dedicated thread: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1519687-known-issues-amirs-shockwave/

item.title: Update 43.5: Amir's Shockwave
item.description:
Image Description: A closeup of Amir’s face in front of an electrified microphone in the opposite orientation of Nora Night’s. A crackling border encloses the Amir’s Shockwave logo as blue and purple arcs of electricity frame the image and Amir’s headset.

UPDATE 43.5: AMIR’S SHOCKWAVE 

Get ready for a shakeup like you've never heard before! Amir Beckett of The Hex is cutting through the airwaves (and across space and time) to bring you a double-dose of 1999-themed content. Not only has he hacked Nora’s airways by hosting his own remixed edition of a Nightwave Mix called Amir’s Shockwave replete with never-before-seen Rewards, but he's also joining the rest of his Hex teammates for a unique KIM narrative adventure, Fables & Frontiers: Running Late. Read on to learn more! 

Transcend the chaos of battle, Tenno… This interim update also delivers the Baruuk Shaoshi Collection! Featuring the Baruuk Shaoshi Skin, Rathan Sword & Shield Skin, Liania Signa and Neviti Ephemera. Get your hands on the new TennoGen: Fables & Frontiers, featuring six new creations from community artists –  including the first TennoGen pieces for Kullervo and Oraxia, two brand new Signas, and more. 

This interim update also includes many changes and fixes (including code!). Some pesky issues such as frozen enemies despawning in Netracell missions, and Nokko’s Reroot Rampage not triggering Archon Continuity or having its first bounce dealing damage have been addressed. We have also added a plethora of quality of life changes for the Nightwave system to make Acts more engaging and removed some longstanding pain points. We also have a dedicated Amir’s Shockwave sub-forum to collect your feedback and bug reports to address in follow-up Hotfixes where we can. 

If any of the terms above are new to you, visit The Warframe Lexicon for Updates to learn more about Warframe’s development cycle. 

Download Sizes:

PC DirectX 11: ~248.94 MB

PC DirectX 12: ~250.68 MB

 

Image Description: Amir smirks while looking at us as he juggles three different dice in his left hand. Behind him is a large tabletop game setup complete with game pieces, dice, maps, and sheets. In the foreground is the logo for Fables & Frontiers.

FABLES & FRONTIERS: RUNNING LATE (MINI KIM ADVENTURE)

Magic! Mayhem! Mystery! Play with Amir as your Fablemaster and the rest of the Hex in a six-day mini KIM text adventure of the popular table top roleplaying game! But be warned, all may not be well in Höllvandeim… Log into the KIM and join the Fables & Frontiers: Running Late campaign! 

NOTE: This is a permanent addition to the KIM system! It is not tied to Amir’s Shockwave Nightwave Mix rotation, meaning it can be experienced at any time once the prerequisites have been met. 

Prerequisites

In order to unlock Fables & Frontiers group chat in the KIM, you must have the following:

  • Complete The Hex Quest & The Hex Finale 
  • Reach Rank 5 (Pizza Party) with The Hex Syndicate 
  • Reach Chemistry Rank 5 (Close) with Amir in the KIM system 

How to Begin

Before embarking on the KIM Fables & Frontiers: Running Late adventure, you must first create your character sheet! Here’s how:

  1. Once you have completed all of the listed prerequisites, travel to Höllvania Central Mall from the POM-2 map. 
  2. Make your way up to the second floor of the mall to the “Höllvandeim” room (read dedicated section to learn more). 
    • You can fast travel to Höllvandeim from the pause menu and from the quick access wheel. 
  3. Ring the bell on the table to call in Amir – he’ll appear with much speed and urgency! 
  4. Interact with Amir to put together a character sheet via dialogue options. You’ll choose your character class and their weaponry/abilities!
  5. Return to the POM-2 to begin the campaign in the KIM! Once you have completed your character sheet and Amir has run off to prepare the campaign, you can return to your POM-2 to begin the campaign in the KIM system. 

 

Image Description: Höllvandeim - a decorated room evoking magic and mystery with desks set up for participants. From left to right we can see the fablemaster’s table with their screen, rule book and notes, then the main table complete with a large map, game pieces and seating for six people.

 

Höllvandeim

Located on the second floor of the Höllvania Central Mall you will find what was once the cafe has been taken over completely by Amir and rebranded it as “Höllvandeim” for his campaign. Gotta love a Fable Master that really prioritizes player immersion! Wonder where he got all the Höllars for these decorations… 

Ring the Bell to Summon Amir! 

A service bell sits on the table near the Fablemaster’s station – ring it to summon Amir to the table! The man will appear with great speed and urgency at your call.

Image Description: Amir stares off into the distance as he stands behind a desk with a pizza box used as his fablemaster screen. To the right in the foreground is a service bell placed atop an upside down popcorn bucket of sorts. 

Interact with Amir to gain access to his wares and other things we won’t spoil at this time! 

NOTE: Amir leaves the Arcade downstairs when rung to Höllvandeim and returns once you leave the room. If he’s downstairs, simply ring the bell again to call him back up. Alternatively, you can jump to him upstairs (using the Höllvandeim option) or downstairs (using the Protoframe, Amir option) using the quick access wheel. Such speed! 

Amir’s Fables & Frontiers Store 

Amir has many Fables & Frontiers goodies and more available for Standing with the Hex in Höllvandeim! Ring the bell to summon him upstairs and peruse his wares. 

For the sake of not spilling all the beans on the kind of mayhem you may get yourself into in the campaign, we chose to not list out each and every unique item in the shop in detail. You’ll just have to complete the campaign to see for yourself! 

  • Fables & Frontiers character Glyphs, one for each Hex member, by community artist ZliDe
  • Character Sheet Posters, one for each Hex member, by community artist Brighan
  • Fables & Frontiers Character Posters, one for each Hex member, by community artist Brighan
  • Several decorations based on the Fables & Frontiers adventure
  • Several Glyphs featuring foes you may encounter in the Fables & Frontiers adventure 
  • A new Somachord track by On-lyne titled “Running Late”

    Image Description: Promotional poster for On-lyne’s new track Running Late with the members running. From left to right are: Harddrive, Packet, Zeke, Drillbit, and DJ RoM.
  • A Fables & Frontiers-themed Somachord track titled “A Byte-sized Adventure” 
  • Running Late Album Cover Display and Promo Poster 
  • Dominion of Höllvandeim Captura Scene
  • The following returned rewards from Nightwave Mix Vol. 8:
    • Big Bytes Pizza Sigil
    • Nightwave Livery
    • Lillian Floof
    • Jillian Floof
    • Battlecry Ink
    • Boltor Kubrow Armor
    • Tammpet Sugatra
    • Aoi Origami Glyph
    • Liset Domestik Drone
  • And so much more!!

What to Expect 

Amir is the Fablemaster, the man at the helm responsible for organizing the campaign and writing the story! He is hosting his latest campaign “Running Late” entirely from a new KIM group chat with you and the Hex, which is available to access from the new Fables & Frontiers Batch tab. 

Image Description: Screenshot of the KIM UI with the Fables & Frontiers Batch tab selected. An unread message from H16h V0l7463 reads “HEY HEY ALL!!”.

You and the Hex will join the group chat and play as your Fables & Frontiers characters:

  • Arthur plays as Cedric Dawnsong 
  • Aoi plays as Morohime Ichigeki 
  • Eleanor plays as Sanguina Kallisti
  • Lettie plays as Ixchel Balam
  • Quincy plays as Lord Reyland Kingsacre

Image Description: Screenshot of the Kinemantik Instant Messenger showing the initial conversation from the Fables & Frontier campaign.

There are six days of adventuring ahead of you, with one session available per day. Amir needs time to plan out what the adventurers will encounter next, so check back after the Daily Reset (0:00 UTC) to continue the story with the Hex! 

This is intended to be a fun role-playing adventure, and for that reason there is no Chemistry earned from the conversations had in the Fables & Frontiers group chat.  

Somewhere along the way in your adventure with the Hex, you will encounter a new enemy… the Surge Eximus! This speedy Eximus unit targets foes with a triple strike of devastating Electric Damage. But where oh where did it come from… 

Rewards 

Completing the Fables & Frontiers campaign will reward you with the following: 

  • Fables & Frontiers: Running Late Poster (Inbox reward)

    Image Description: Poster depicting members of The Hex as a party of fantastical characters such as a Warlock, Knight, and Sorcerer. Looming over them in an ominous manner appears to be Amir.
    • Cover art for the Fables & Frontiers: Running Late adventure. Artwork by community artist Nikki Dawes. 
  • Access to Replay KIM Campaign
    • Like all other KIM batches, you can reset your memories with Fables & Frontiers from the Digital Grimoire to replay the adventure! You may also do this by talking to Amir. Doing so will erase all conversation history from the Fables & Frontiers batch and allow you to take another stab at the campaign.

      Image Description: Screenshot of the Digital Grimoire UI with Amir’s Shockwave Fables & Frontiers selected. The option to reset your memories is shown with a yellow Commit button visible.
    • After resetting your memories you may choose to replay your experience by selecting the same character as before, or you can explore the campaign through the lens of a different character by choosing another one instead. 
    • Please note that resetting your memories will temporarily remove access to Amir’s Fables & Frontiers Store until you talk to him and create a character sheet.

 

  

Image Description: A closeup of Amir’s face in front of an electrified microphone in the opposite orientation of Nora Night’s. A crackling border encloses the Amir’s Shockwave logo as blue and purple arcs of electricity frame the image and Amir’s headset.

NIGHTWAVE MIX: AMIR’S SHOCKWAVE 

BEGINS TODAY @ 11:30 AM ET

Cred Offerings Store Updates 

Amir’s takeover brings many updates to the Cred Offerings Store! Earn Amir’s Shockwave Creds from the reward tiers and trade them in for both new and returning items. Let’s take a look at some of the new revisions and adjustments below. 

Permanent Cred Offerings

The following rewards are now available at all times in the Cred Offerings Store – in other words, they are no longer part of the store rotations and are now permanent fixtures in the store. These are in addition to the existing permanent offerings, which remain unchanged.

    Image Description: A Landing Craft ship with winged components on each side and two small “tails” angled outwards at the back. It features a deep purple body, light green emissives, and orange energy with a high gloss shine. 
    • We first introduced the Nightwave Landing Craft in Nightwave Series 3: Glassmaker and from there was rotated back into various Nightwave Mixes tier rewards. Instead of continuing to add it as a tier reward, we have instead decided to add its Blueprint and Components as a permanent addition to the Cred Offerings shop.

  • 6 Weapon Augment Mods are now guaranteed in each rotation.

      • Contains permanent store resources (Kuva, Nitain Extract, Orokin Reactor/Catalyst, etc.) and blueprints (Nightwave Landing Craft & Vauban).

  • Removed a duplicate Clip Delegation from the Cred Offerings rotation.

 

New Nightwave Acts

  • Daily Acts:
    • Whole Arsenal – Get a kill with your Primary, Secondary and Melee weapons within 10 seconds. 
    • Artist – Customize a piece of equipment’s colours. 
  • Weekly Acts:
    • To Ashes – Dissolve an Arcane for Vosfor. 
    • Bow Offense – Kill 150 enemies with a Primary Bow. 
    • Rifle Offense – Kill 150 enemies with a Primary Rifle. 
    • Sniper Offense – Kill 150 enemies with a Primary Sniper Rifle. 
    • Shotgun Offense – Kill 150 enemies with a Primary Shotgun. 
    • Void Net – Collect 30 Void Traces. 
  • Elite Weekly Acts:
    • Elementary, My Dear – Complete 3 successful Conversions in the Alchemy game mode. 
    • Going Down – Defeat Roathe in Descendia. 
    • Hold the Mushrooms – Collect 6 mushrooms from the Deepmines. 
    • Battle Hardened – Complete the Perita Rebellion with 6 or more orders completed. 
    • Spider Hunt – Complete an Isleweaver Duviri Mission. 
    • Treasure from the Past – Complete a Netracell. 

 

Nightwave Act Updates

Act Changes

  • The Hunt is On (Daily)
    • Previously: Find 5 Syndicate Medallions
    • Changes:
      • Increased required Syndicate Medallions from 5 to 10 
      • Changed from Daily to Weekly
  • Earth/Venus/Zariman Bounty Hunter (Weekly)
    • Previously:“Complete x/3 different Bounties…” on Earth/Venus or “Complete x/4 different Bounties in the Zariman”.
    • Changes:
      • No longer requires different Bounties
      • Changed Zariman Act from Weekly to Elite Weekly
  • Now Boarding (Weekly)
    • Previously: Complete 3 different K-Drive races in Orb Vallis on Venus or in Cambion Drift on Deimos
    • Change: Reduced required K-Drive races from 3 to 1
  • Eternal Guardian (Weekly)
    • Previously: Complete 2 Void Armageddon missions
    • Changes: 
      • Progress counts 2 Armageddon round completions instead of mission completions
      • Changed from Weekly to Elite Weekly
  • High Ground (Weekly)
    • Previously: Complete 3 Void Flood Missions
    • Changes: 
      • Progress counts 12 Ruptures Sealed rather than missions completions
      • Changed from Weekly to Elite Weekly
  • Finely Tuned (Weekly)
    • Previously: Play 2 different Shawzin songs in Duviri
    • Changes: 
      • Now only requires player to play 1 Shawzin song
      • Updated the description to specify that it requires the Shawzin activity, not the Emote.
  • Cache Hunter (Weekly)
    • Previously: Find 6 caches across any Sabotage missions
    • Changes: 
      • Caches found in non-sabotage missions will count towards progress
      • Updated description and tip to make locations of eligible Caches clearer to players
  • Perplexed (Elite Weekly)
    • Previously: Complete 3 puzzles in Duviri
    • Changes: 
      • Reduced puzzles from 3 to 1
      • Changed from Elite Weekly to Weekly
  • Day Trader (Elite Weekly)
    • Previously: Win 3 wagers in a row without letting the enemy score in one match of The Index
    • Changes: 
      • Removed the “without letting the enemy score” stipulation
      • This Act is no longer locked behind The Glast Gambit quest as it is not required to access The Index
  • Elite Explorer (Elite Weekly)
    • Previously: Complete 8 Railjack Missions
    • Change: Reduced mission requirements from 8 to 6
  • Fallen Angel (Elite Weekly)
    • Previously: Kill 5 Void Angels in The Zariman
    • Change: Reduced Void Angels from 5 to 3

Act Removals 

Removed the following Railjack Acts: 

  • Confiscated - Hijack a Crewship from the Enemy
  • Friendly Fire - While piloting Hijacked Crewship, destroy 3 enemy fighters

These were removed as they were difficult to complete while playing in a Squad as it required you to essentially compete against your teammates to hijack a Crewship and kill enemies. 

Quality of Life Changes

  • Recovering an Act now prioritizes Acts that are not locked. 
  • Updated various Acts to be locked behind Quest/Junction/etc. requirements. 
    • The main reason for this effort is to play off of the Recovered Act change listed above. Prioritizing unlocked Acts means little if the Act recovered is still uncompletable. We’ve done our best to select minimum Lock criteria to access the content for the Act, to maintain flexibility where possible.
    • Vox Solaris:
      • Conservationist
      • Now Boarding
      • Venus Bounty Hunter
      • Venus Fisher
      • Venus Miner
    • Howl of the Kubrow:

    • Duviri Paradox:
      • Beast Slayer
      • Horsin’ Around

      • I Decree
    • Stolen Dreams:
      • Animator
    • The Archwing:
      • Explorer
      • Flawless
      • Elite Explorer
    • The New Strange:
      • Test Subject
      • Sanctuary Researcher
    • Heart of Deimos:
      • Vault Raider
      • Feed the Beast
      • Mirror, Mirror (also requires MR 3)
    • Mastery Rank 3:
      • Supporter
    • Angels of the Zariman:
      • Fallen Angel
    • Mars Junction: 
      • Unlock Relics (and Elite version)
    • Eris Junction:
      • Vital Arbiter
  • Updated various Act tips to help clarify how to complete them. 
  • The Antiquarian Act now indicates what Relic types have already been unlocked. 
  • Improved Weekly Act scheduling so there should be no more repeating Weekly Nightwave Acts (excluding the Permanent Weeklies) in a series.

 

Image Description: Baruuk Shaoshi poses with his Rathan Sword & Shield, and Neviti Ephemera as if preparing to fight within the Sanctum Anatomica. Emanating from his morningstar-like sword, buckler-like shield, and stole-like ephemera is an almost spectral purple energy.

This bundle contains the following items, which can all be purchased separately:

Baruuk Shaoshi Skin

Rathan Sword & Shield Skin

Baruuk Shaoshi’s signature Sword & Shield skin evokes the ancient arms carried by sacred guardians, those who embraced the balance between defense and attack.

Liania Signa

The dignified drape of Baruuk Shaoshi’s signature Signa is the mark of a warrior committed to defending peace - by any means necessary.

Neviti Ephemera

CHANGES

Sirius & Orion Changes 

  • Sirius & Orion’s Jade Stars now uses (improved) Line of Sight.
    • With our buffs to it earlier this summer, Jade Stars has become an exponentially popular Helminth ability due to its interactions with far-reaching Damage over Time abilities like Saryn’s Spores. Our goal is to keep Jade Stars feeling powerful and impactful, but avoid situations where it can continually wipe the map without actually seeing the enemies it’s killing (ie standing in a corner and triggering Jade Stars on repeat).
  • Sirius & Orion’s Celestial Clash now deals guaranteed Status Effects depending on which Son is Clashing.
    • Sirius deals Heat Damage with a guaranteed Heat Status Effect.
    • Orion deals Slash Damage with a guaranteed Slash Status Effect.
  • Sirius & Orion will no longer swap to the Primary Son when using an item from the Gear Wheel

General Changes

  • Weapons with locked Explosion Radius now display a lock icon on that stat in the Arsenal. 
  • Improved the flow when starting the Chimera Prologue from the Codex if you have another Active Quest.
    • Previously, a certain interaction would not trigger if a different quest was set to Active. Now, starting the Chimera Prologue will clear all Active Quests so the interaction can occur. 
  • Enemy Highlights now apply to the Targets in the Mastery Rank 6 and Legendary Rank 6 tests. 
    • Also improved the visibility of lines between the targets in these tests. 
  • Resetting settings to Defaults now offers players the option to reset All Settings to default, or just the current Tab’s settings. 
  • Improved the dodge hint in the final segment of The Old Peace quest. 
  • Railjack reticles are now solid white to improve their visibility. 
  • Removed an incorrect Electric Shield ability tip for Volt. 
  • Removed flashing VFX from Void Fissures in-mission to address photosensitivity concerns.
  • Made adjustments to the Commandeered Prime spawn SFX and mine explosion SFX in The Perita Rebellion. 
  • The "Mission Tutorial Transmissions" toggle now applies to transmissions in Persto Survival and Hell-Scrub missions.
  • Background transmissions, such as Ordis chatter or start chart notifications, are now muted when viewing the Inbox.

  • Fixed a minor hitch when joining a mission with a Sirius & Orion present.
